items.description: A vulnerability was determined in Tenda RX3 16.03.13.11_multi. Impacted is the function R7WebsSecurityHandler of the component httpd. Executing a manipulation can lead to improper authentication. The attack may be launched remotely. The exploit has been publicly disclosed and may be utilized.
